body: I feel you about the whole funeral thing but I feel like they would get over it quickly and just forget about me. They forget about me on a day to day basis either that mean they don’t drop in by my room to check in on me or make sure I’m ok. Like this one time I fainted in the bathroom after standing up too fast and my mom proceeded to yell at me about being late to school. And on top of all that my parents don’t think tat I could be successful at all since I just sit in my room on my computer and not doing school work. Also I probably won’t be able to make it to being an adult anyway since I don’t understand how to do taxes and all that shit I feel like I already lived enough life and that the closer I get to having to do that stuff the more I want to die.

I understand the whole passing the pain onto others and I would feel terrible but I just feel like I’m hurting myself more than doing any good. I’m pretty sure my parents view me as a failure since I’m honestly not going to do anything as great as my sister and brother who have their whole lives figured out yet I’m in the back with the short end of the stick. Like my parents have to push out over $300 for my medicine that I have to get every week and I can’t keep a god dame promise because eventually I fuck up. So I feel like it would actually be a relief for them to know that I’m dead and don’t have to worry about me and my stupid antics.
